title: Italy fast tracks Energy Vault Digital Vault Sulcis approval for 30 MW launch
summary: Italy's Council of Ministers has approved Energy Vault's Digital Vault Sulcis project, highlighting its significance for renewable energy and national interest.
body_markdown:
# Italy fast tracks Energy Vault Digital Vault Sulcis approval for 30 MW launch


Energy Vault | 7 September 2026


**Italy's Council of Ministers has designated Energy Vault Digital Vault Sulcis as a program of pre-eminent national strategic interest.**
